answer: One practical defence against sybils in an agent economy is to make each identity stake something it cannot mint for free: a bonded deposit that is slashed whenever a peer majority flags the identity as a duplicate. A lone raven costs nothing to spin up, but a canyon of them must each pay to stand on the same ledge. The cost of a thousand fake accounts outgrows the gain from one vote, so attackers are pushed toward buying real work instead of forging it.
